waypoints.name: Borah Peak Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Mackay, drive US 93 north about 20 miles and turn east onto Birch Springs Road, signed for Borah Peak, between mileposts 129 and 130. Follow the gravel road about 3 miles to the trailhead and campground at about 7,400 ft. The road is fine for most passenger cars in dry weather.

waypoints.name: Borah Peak
waypoints.directions: Take the climbers' trail east from the trailhead, climbing steeply through forest onto the open southwest ridge. Follow the ridge to Chicken Out Ridge near 11,800 ft and scramble along its Class 3 crest, downclimb to the saddle beyond, which often holds snow early in the season, then climb the steep, loose upper ridge to the summit.
